causalRedClassification.rootCause: For file-backed WhatsApp media, provider acceptance can occur before canonical local media projection succeeds. The resulting outbound-media-upsert repair plan retains only the caller-owned filePath and expectedSha256. persistLocalPersistenceRepair durably enqueues that path reference without taking ownership of the bytes. If the transient source disappears before repair or restart recovery, LocalPersistenceRepairService.apply follows source.filePath and cannot reconstruct the local projection. The frozen RED serializes repairInput exactly at persistLocalPersistenceRepair and then deletes the path, proving that downstream worker-only changes cannot close the durability contract.
causalRedClassification.requiredOwningLayerChange: Change backend/services/durableOperations/outboundMessageSendOperation.js only. Before enqueueLocalPersistenceRepair returns a durable receipt, detect outbound-media-upsert with a non-empty source.filePath, synchronously read the source bytes while they are still available, verify expectedSha256 when provided, and replace the path-only source with existing bufferBase64 byte custody. Preserve the same repair id/queue/platform/account/message/descriptor contract. Any custody read or integrity failure after provider acceptance must flow through the existing WP_B_OUTBOUND_LOCAL_REPAIR_DURABILITY_UNCERTAIN fail-closed wrapper with automatic resend blocked. Do not alter localPersistenceRepairService, repository schema or WhatsApp provider dispatch.
